run.objective: Prove that the configured Claudex launcher and its Luna workflow can inspect this package and return a validated structured handoff without modifying files

nodes.prompt: Use Workflow agent() exactly once with model:'gpt-5.6-luna' and effort:'max'; ask it only to reply LUNA_OK. After it succeeds, read package.json, README.md, and docs/SPEC.md yourself and confirm that Claudex is a first-class executor with launcher-owned model routing. Include the Luna marker and file evidence in the handoff. Do not edit any file.
